items.a: For every Syrian living outside Syria who wants to pay their family’s bills or top up their phones. The app is for people aged 18 and over.

items.q: Which countries can I use it from?
items.a: qareeb is for Syrians wherever they live outside Syria: Europe, the Gulf, Türkiye, Lebanon, Jordan, Egypt, North America and beyond.

items.q: Which services are available at launch?
items.a: Phone, internet, electricity and water bills, plus Syriatel and MTN credit — with saved numbers so you can repeat a payment in one tap.
By card through Stripe, or with Apple Pay and Google Pay. We never store your card number.
If a transfer doesn’t arrive after you’ve paid, you get a full refund automatically.

You sign in with a one-time code by WhatsApp or email, and your data is always encrypted. Payments go through Stripe, we don’t store your card details, and we’re GDPR-compliant.
